description.zh:
回调鉴权密钥，长度为16~32个字符，只允许填大小写字母和数字。
>当NotifyReqAuth参数值为**yes**时该参数必填。
description.en:
The callback authentication key. The key must be 16 to 32 characters in length and can contain letters and digits.

> This parameter is required when NotifyReqAuth is set to **yes**.

description.zh:
回调鉴权开关。取值：

- **yes**：开启。

- **no**：关闭。

>默认值为**no**，当填**yes**时NotifyAuthKey必填。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable authentication for callback notifications. Valid values:

- **yes**: Enables

- **no**: Disables

> The default value is **no**. If you set this parameter to **yes**, NotifyAuthKey is required.

description.zh: 回调URL，必须是合法URL，长度不超过500。
description.en: The callback URL. The URL must be valid and cannot exceed 500 characters.

descriptions.zh: 本接口的单用户QPS限制为30次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en: You can call this operation up to 30 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live update-live-snapshot-notify-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name ww.yourdomain000.com --notify-url http://callback.yourdomain000.com --notify-req-auth yes --notify-auth-key testkeyyourkey12 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live UpdateLiveSnapshotNotifyConfig --region cn-hangzhou --DomainName 'ww.yourdomain000.com' --NotifyUrl 'http://callback.yourdomain000.com' --NotifyReqAuth yes --NotifyAuthKey testkeyyourkey12 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
